summary: Maine Memory describes a 36-foot wooden fire tower on Mitchell Mountain (1918), replaced by a steel tower in 1927; the FFLA list marks the site gone.

notes_for_editor: The 1918 wooden tower and 1927 steel replacement come from one Maine Memory catalog entry (record 19122); the record's tower sentences do not name the mountain, so the attribution rests on the record's title and description. Nothing found says when the steel tower came down or what became of it; the FFLA list marks the site gone. Conversion: 36 ft is about 11 m. Two 1920 items on Maine Memory and Digital Maine (the Haynes photo and the Mitchell panorama) could be added as photos once image URLs and licences are checked. Our record already matches the FFLA list (tower, Aroostook, gone); no corrections proposed.
